tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and post background. Text on it: text-base, text-muted, primary.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Layers that sit on background (header bar, menus). On posts: the digits on flip-clock tiles (exactly as the countdown on scipy.in colours them), and the text on call-to-action pills and 'Today' markers.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Code blocks and tinted areas on the website. Posts use post-panel instead.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Strongest text on posts: the wordmark, the event line, headlines, key phrases and the tag. Reads on background, surface, post-panel and secondary-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on the website, card titles, the announcement band and the 'Add to calendar' pill.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings on the website; same as text-base.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the website: navigation, dates, captions and metadata on background and surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and pill borders and dividers on the website; the 2px outline of panels on posts.

tokens.name: border-muted
tokens.usage: Faint dividers inside cards and tables.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand teal: links, solid buttons, the flip-clock tiles, and the default series colour on posts (tiles, icons, 'today' markers, call-to-action pills). As text it passes 4.5:1 on background in both themes and on dark surface; on light surface (4.4:1) use it at 24px+ or bold 19px+, or use link-higher-contrast.

tokens.name: primary-highlight
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill of solid primary buttons on the website.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Text on solid primary buttons on the website. (Pills on posts use on-background.)

tokens.name: primary-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind primary content.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Brand purple: outline buttons and link hover. Passes 4.5:1 on background in both themes; on dark surface (3.4:1) use it only for text 24px+, borders or icons. An alternative series colour for countdown posts.

tokens.name: secondary-highlight
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of secondary fills.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Text on secondary fills, including outline buttons on hover.

tokens.name: secondary-bg
tokens.usage: The announcement band at the top of scipy.in (text-base text) and the 'Call for proposals' tag on posts (on-surface text).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pink accent, sparingly: an alternative series colour for countdown posts, small highlights. Never for body text.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind accent content.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on background.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link text on hover.

tokens.name: link-higher-contrast
tokens.usage: Links on surface and tinted backgrounds, such as the announcement band, where primary falls short of 4.5:1.

tokens.name: inline-code
tokens.usage: Inline code text on the website.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Note admonitions on the website. Pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of info admonitions.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and 'open' states. Pair with a word or icon; never told apart from danger by hue alone.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of success admonitions.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and deadlines in admonitions. Fill or border only in light theme (below 4.5:1 as text on white).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning admonitions.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of danger admonitions.

tokens.name: scipy-blue
tokens.usage: The SciPy logo's disc only. Part of the mark, never a UI or text colour.

tokens.name: tile-low
tokens.usage: Lower half of a primary flip-clock tile: primary under tile-shade, as scipy.in's countdown draws it. For secondary or accent tiles, lay tile-shade over the tile colour instead.

tokens.name: tile-shade
tokens.usage: Black at 14% (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)), laid over the lower half of every flip-clock tile.

tokens.name: tile-fold
tokens.usage: Black at 40% (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)): the fold line across the middle of a flip-clock tile, 3px on posts and 2px on the banner.

tokens.name: post-text
tokens.usage: Supporting lines and running text on posts; the key phrase inside them switches to on-surface at 700.

tokens.name: post-muted
tokens.usage: Small print on posts: progress-strip dates, calendar weekdays and note, chart labels, footer icons, the story's closing line, the banner card's labels.

tokens.name: post-panel
tokens.usage: Fill of panels on posts: the countdown calendar and the story's day bars. Outline: 2px border.

tokens.name: post-outline
tokens.usage: Outline of upcoming days and the strike through past days in the countdown calendar.

tokens.name: post-grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper grid on square, portrait and story posts: 2px lines every 54px over background.

tokens.name: post-rule
tokens.usage: Footer divider and elapsed days in the progress strip on square posts; outline of crossed-out days in the countdown calendar; the divider in the banner's countdown card.

tokens.name: post-past
tokens.usage: Numbers of days already gone in the countdown calendar, crossed out. 3.3:1 on light post-panel and 4.0:1 on dark, so only at 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: post-bar-past
tokens.usage: Fill of elapsed days in the story's day bars.

tokens.name: post-bar-outline
tokens.usage: 3px outline of upcoming days in the story's day bars.

tokens.name: post-banner
tokens.usage: Background of the 16:9 call-for-proposals banner. Text on it: post-banner-heading, post-banner-text and post-banner-link.

tokens.name: post-banner-grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper grid on the banner: 2px lines every 45px over post-banner.

tokens.name: post-banner-heading
tokens.usage: Wordmark, event line and headline on the banner.

tokens.name: post-banner-text
tokens.usage: Supporting text on the banner.

tokens.name: post-banner-link
tokens.usage: The link beside the call-to-action pill on the banner. In light it follows the series colour (primary by default); 4.4:1 on post-banner, so keep it bold 19px+.

families.sans: system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "Source Code Pro", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

groups.name: Website
groups.note: scipy.in's PyData Sphinx theme: the system font, headings at 600 on 1.15, body 16px on 1.65.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Minor headings.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Small headings.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: The smallest heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An international scientific computing and open source software conference.
styles.usage: Running text. Card titles use it at 700; buttons use it on 1.5.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Pill buttons, captions, metadata.

groups.name: Social posts
groups.note: Sizes for 1080px-wide canvases. Where a format differs, the usage gives its size; the banner (1200px wide) has its own, smaller set.

styles.name: post-numeral
styles.usage: Flip-clock digits: 290px on square, 266px on portrait, 160px on the banner. Last-day time tiles: 190px square, 180px portrait, 78px banner.

styles.name: post-story-numeral
styles.usage: The single big number on stories, in on-surface, letter-spacing -0.02em.

styles.name: post-display
styles.usage: 'Days left' and 'Last day' on square and portrait. Stories: 'days left' at 110px in the series colour; 'Last day' at 180px on 0.9. The line under it: 32px post-text on square, 34px on stories; portrait sets one centred 46px/600 line with 'Days left' in the series colour.

styles.name: post-wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the logo: 38px on square and portrait, 40px on stories, 28px on the banner.

styles.name: post-banner-title
styles.sample: Submit your workshop, talk, or poster
styles.usage: The banner's headline, balanced over two lines.

styles.name: post-headline
styles.sample: Workshops, talks, and posters on scientific computing
styles.usage: Supporting line in post-text; set the key phrase in 700 and on-surface. Square 36px on 1.3; portrait 30px on 1.35; story 36px on 1.35; banner 21px on 1.45.

styles.name: post-cta
styles.usage: Call-to-action pill text: 30px on portrait, 32px on stories, 22px on the banner.

styles.name: post-event
styles.usage: Date and venue line, with icons: 27px on square and portrait, 29px on stories, 21px on the banner.

styles.name: post-tag
styles.usage: Tag pill text on every format; the banner's plain 'Call for proposals' label.

styles.name: post-footer
styles.usage: Deadline and link in the square post's footer (link at 700). Stories set the closing line at 26px.

styles.name: post-caption
styles.usage: Progress-strip dates on square posts; the 'Today' pill on stories (at 700).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code on the website. On stories, the chart header is 22px and the bar values 24px at 700.

spacing.note: The website uses Bootstrap's spacers (0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 3rem), which are space-1, space-2, space-4, space-5 and space-7. space-3 and space-6 fill the gaps for graphics. The 2026 templates also use a few in-between values (10, 14, 18, 20, 22, 26px) in tight spots; prefer the steps in new work.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Bootstrap spacer 1. Tight gaps, such as between the two lines of the banner card's date.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Bootstrap spacer 2. Between the logo and the name in the website header; between buttons in a row; padding of the announcement band.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in the event line; bar-to-label gap in the progress strip; between the banner's tiles and the story's day bars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Bootstrap spacer 3. Card padding on the website; gap between flip-clock tiles on posts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bootstrap spacer 4. Between the lockup and the tag; between the stacked header lines on stories.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inner padding of panels on posts (30–40px in the 2026 templates).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Bootstrap spacer 5. Between the banner's two columns.

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the 1080×1080 square post, all sides.

tokens.name: post-margin-portrait
tokens.usage: Side margin of the 1080×1350 portrait post; top and bottom are 76px.

tokens.name: story-margin
tokens.usage: Side margin of 1080×1920 stories.

tokens.name: story-safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep text below this on stories (app chrome covers the top).

tokens.name: story-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep text above this on stories (reply bar covers the bottom).

tokens.name: post-margin-banner
tokens.usage: Side margin of the 1200×675 banner; top and bottom are 56px.

radius.note: Squared off on the website; softer, larger shapes on posts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Website cards and buttons; the countdown tiles on scipy.in.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels on posts (the countdown calendar, the story's day bars, the banner's countdown card) and the small time tiles on 'Last day' posts. Calendar cells and the banner's day tiles use 10px, its small time tiles 6px.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Flip-clock tiles on square and portrait posts (about 8% of the tile's width). Stories use a single big numeral instead of tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, pill buttons, call-to-action pills, progress-strip bars.

shadow.note: Cards on the website only, and the shadow differs by theme. Posts are flat.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the website in light theme.

tokens.name: shadow-card-dark
tokens.usage: Cards on the website in dark theme.
